compiled_state.title: Code review telemetry infrastructure: ingest endpoint, canonical schema, stats retrieval
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

DSO has no central data store for code review telemetry. PR history is per-repo and not queryable across host projects. Telemetry contracts exist (`classifier-telemetry.jsonl`, `review-event-schema.jsonl`) but have no consumers and no central aggregation.

## Scope

A logging-shape ingest pipeline: write-only-unauthenticated POST endpoint for clients (events categorized by `client_id`, schema-versioned), queries restricted to maintainer auth. Backed by append-only JSONL on object storage (Cloudflare-Worker + R2/D1, or equivalent). Designed to support future host-project contributions without GitHub auth coordination — host projects opt in by setting `telemetry.endpoint` + `telemetry.client_id` config.

**Hard rule**: the in-flight arbiter (Epic 1) reads cross-reviewer signals live from `gh api` only, never from this store. The store is for reporting/monitoring, not for live review decisions.

Includes a validation-grade stats-retrieval CLI sufficient to confirm telemetry is being captured correctly. Full reporting/dashboards deferred to the placeholder reporting epic.

## Approach (to be brainstormed)

- Canonical event schema (tool-agnostic, `client_id` + `tool_id` keyed)
- Telemetry endpoint deployment (Cloudflare Worker, AWS Lambda + S3, or similar)
- `telemetry.endpoint` + `telemetry.client_id` config knobs
- Maintainer-auth query path (DuckDB-over-store CLI is sufficient for v1)
- Stats-retrieval CLI / `/dso:review-stats` extension for in-session validation

## Dependencies

None — foundational.

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>`.
